new_points.title: Rules, London’s oldest restaurant, donated to National Trust

new_points.title: Dogs are susceptible to the bouba-kiki effect
new_points.content: Just like humans, dogs seem to associate the nonsense word “bouba” with a rounded shape and “kiki” with a spiky shape, suggesting the connection stems from brain mechanisms that are shared between species

new_points.title: Asian Stocks Gain Before US CPI Data, Oil Climbs: Markets Wrap
new_points.content: Asian stocks rose ahead of key US inflation data as expectations grew that the Federal Reserve may not need to raise interest rates aggressively next year. Crude oil advanced.

new_points.title: Bank of America Fined More Than $1.2 Billion for Money-Laundering

new_points.title: Hong Kong’s Low Aggregate Balance Sparks Rate Volatility Concern
